entities.name: Royal hunters
entities.description: Elite servants of Baron Sengir on Ulgrotha who scout and kill his enemies in the Great Wood.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Vampire lord of Ulgrotha served by the royal hunters.

entities.name: Great Wood
entities.description: Forest where Sengir's enemies lay hidden.

events.summary: Sengir found a hunter for reconnaissance and killing rather than turning him into a vampire.
events.quote: he found himself a hunter who would do the reconnaissance and the needed killing for him

events.summary: The royal hunters brought Sengir information and the heads of important enemies for generations.
